team.name: echo-intel-demo
team.description: 回声智能最小可运行 Demo：严格对齐 V2.0 客户服务 Team（4 Worker + 5 Skill），验证售前方案推荐闭环的可执行方案率≥80%。

creation_policy.rule: Create the next business Worker only after the previous Worker is created and verified healthy. During Team creation, manager must create customer-journey-leader as a dedicated TeamLeader Worker (role = Customer Journey Leader).

team_leader.name: customer-journey-leader
team_leader.creation: created by manager during Team creation
team_leader.rule: Must be created as a new independent Worker and designated as TeamLeader. Do not designate any business Worker as leader.

task_submission_policy.mention: （无需 @，将需求整体发给 Manager 房间即可）
task_submission_policy.rule: AgentTeams 的 Worker/Leader 为被动调度：用户必须在 Manager 房间发送需求，由 Manager 调度 customer-journey-leader，Leader 再调度各业务 Worker。不要在 Team 房间直接 @leader（不会触发响应）。逐条发送，等报告输出后再发下一条。详见 at/send_to_manager.md。
task_submission_policy.note: 本字段为回填修正（2026-08-16 @hotcoffeeshake）：原「Team 房间 @leader」描述与运行行为不一致，真实机制以 at/send_to_manager.md 为准。
